Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the director of “Blind Corner” by relying on an incorrect SERP/Wikipedia snippet that listed Edward Sloman as the director. The 1964 film “Blind Corner” (a.k.a. “Man in the Dark”) was directed by Lance Comfort (born 1908), not Edward Sloman (born 1883). This lack of verification/cross-checking led to using the wrong birth date, which in turn caused the Planner to conclude the wrong film had the later-born director.
